companies.name: Emerson Electric Co.
companies.description: Emerson Electric Co. designs and manufactures automation and control technologies, including process control systems, valves and actuators, sensing and analytical instruments, and HVAC/refrigeration controls, and provides related software and services. They primarily sell to industrial operators, OEMs, building and facilities managers, and systems integrators. They position themselves as a single-source supplier of control hardware, instrumentation, and software to support operational control and equipment lifecycle needs.

companies.name: Honeywell International, Inc.
companies.description: Honeywell International, Inc. is an American multinational conglomerate headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, specializing in aerospace, building technologies, performance materials, and industrial automation. Founded in 1906, the company provides a comprehensive range of products and services, including aircraft engines, avionics, integrated security and building management systems, advanced chemicals, and warehouse automation solutions. Its offerings include specialized software and hardware platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency, safety, and sustainability across global industrial and commercial sectors. The target market includes commercial airlines, defense agencies, manufacturing enterprises, and infrastructure developers seeking standardized industrial solutions and specialized technical expertise to support the global energy transition and digital transformation.

companies.name: ABB Asea Brown Boveri Ltd.
companies.description: ABB is a technology leader in electrification and automation, offering a wide range of products and services to enable a more sustainable and resource-efficient future. Their typical customers are industrial and manufacturing companies, as well as businesses in the energy sector. ABB differentiates themselves by connecting engineering know-how and software to optimize how things are manufactured, moved, powered, and operated, driving innovations that accelerate industrial transformation.

companies.name: Continental AG
companies.description: Continental AG is a leading automotive manufacturing company that specializes in producing tires, brake systems, automotive safety, powertrain components, and other automotive parts. Their typical customers include automotive manufacturers, car dealerships, and individuals looking to replace or upgrade their vehicle components. Continental positions itself as a provider of innovative and high-quality automotive solutions, emphasizing their commitment to safety, sustainability, and cutting-edge technology.

companies.name: Siemens AG
companies.description: Siemens AG is a global technology company that focuses on electrification, automation, and digitalization. Their products and services range from power generation and distribution to medical imaging and industrial automation. Their typical customers include energy providers, manufacturers, healthcare institutions, and infrastructure companies. Siemens differentiates itself through its focus on innovation, sustainability, and providing comprehensive solutions for their customers' needs.

companies.name: SGS Société Générale de Surveillance SA
Cambria County Association For The Blind And Handicapped

companies.description: CMP Products design and manufacture cable glands, cable cleats and accessories for industrial and hazardous-area installations. They primarily serve business customers such as engineers, contractors, OEMs and system integrators across sectors like transportation, food & beverage, electronics and robotics, and they market themselves as specialists with product ranges that cover multiple international installation codes and include innovations such as the TruSeal strain-relief glands.
companies.name: CMP Products

companies.description: Maverick Power designs and deploys flexible power design solutions, specializing in electrical control and distribution systems with a focus on safety and reliability. Their typical customers include data center infrastructure providers, large utility and information service providers, and companies with complex power needs such as critical power solutions. They position themselves as a provider of customized solutions that go beyond typical fulfillment, delivering specific engineered solutions to meet their customers' exact needs and overcome challenging physical constraints.
companies.name: Maverick Power

companies.description: Harger Lightning & Grounding manufactures lightning protection equipment, grounding and bonding hardware, and exothermic welding products for business customers across utilities, telecom, solar, rail, commercial and industrial markets, and promotes proprietary welding technology, installer-focused components, design support, training, and digital tools as differentiators.
companies.name: Harger Lightning & Grounding

companies.description: Eaton is a multinational power management company that offers a range of electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical power solutions. Their products and services cater to a wide variety of industries including electrical systems and components for industrial and commercial customers, aerospace fuel, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems for aerospace and defense customers, and vehicle powertrain, and automation systems for automotive and industrial customers. Eaton positions itself as a company that enables its customers to manage power more efficiently, safely, and sustainably through its innovative solutions and expertise.
companies.name: Eaton

companies.description: Motor City Electric Technologies Inc. is an electrical contracting company that provides a wide range of services including electrical construction, design-build, and technology solutions. Their typical customers are commercial and industrial clients in various sectors such as healthcare, education, manufacturing, and government. They differentiate themselves by offering innovative and cost-effective solutions, while also emphasizing their expertise in delivering complex projects on time and within budget.
companies.name: Motor City Electric Technologies Inc.
Patriot Industries
companies.description: Patriot Industries Steel ~ Aluminum ~ Stainless manufactures and distributes rigid aluminum and stainless steel electrical conduit and fittings for electrical distributors, contractors, and OEMs, and offers custom-length fabrication, project bundles, subassembly, field support/training, and a branded delivery program. They emphasize American-owned manufacturing, veteran hiring, no upcharge for custom/broken bundles, and fast/free delivery with no minimums as distinguishing claims.

companies.name: Modular Power & Data
companies.description: Modular Power & Data manufactures and integrates modular power distribution equipment—primarily custom and packaged panelboards and switchboards—and provides engineering and equipment integration services for data center, industrial, and commercial customers, claiming faster lead times, ISO 9001 certification, and greater nimbleness versus other contractors and manufacturers.

companies.name: eVolve MEP
companies.description: eVolve MEP develops software for MEP contractors and VDC/prefab teams, offering Revit extensions and shop/fabrication applications to automate detailing, spooling, and shop workflows. They target mechanical and electrical contractors and fabrication shops and claim to provide visibility into model-driven production, faster detailing, and automated fabrication outputs to support prefab and shop operations.

companies.name: Wesanco Zsi
companies.description: ZSi-Foster offers a range of reliable products, including hydraulic clamps, hydraulic and pneumatic quick disconnects, hose, pipe, and tube fittings. ZSi and Wesanco, both part of the Ideal Tridon Group, provide an extensive product portfolio. Their offerings include metal framing, channels, fittings, cushioned clamps, insulated clamps, rooftop support systems, and strut. These products are domestically manufactured and are available in various finishes. The companies serve a diverse set of industries and markets, such as semiconductor plants, cloud storage data centers, industrial manufacturing, and commercial facilities. ZSi is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, while Wesanco operates manufacturing facilities across the United States.

companies.name: Wera Tools North America
companies.description: Wera Tools North America manufactures and sells hand tools and tool systems—notably torque tools, ratchets, screwdrivers, bits, and storage solutions—serving both trade professionals and retail consumers. They emphasize feature-led claims such as Torque Lock functionality, fast torque setting, ratcheting products, in-house calibration capability, and personalized tools, alongside digital support (apps/AR) and service offerings.

companies.name: ELECTRI International
companies.description: ELECTRI International funds, coordinates, and monitors research for the electrical construction industry and publishes reports, benchmarking tools, and guidance aimed at electrical contractors and industry stakeholders; they position themselves as a central research resource and convening organization for industry research and practitioner tools.

companies.name: Kace Communications
companies.description: Kace Communications provides low-voltage communications contracting focused on structured data cabling and fiber optic installation for business customers such as commercial offices, financial firms, contractors, and data centers. They claim differentiation through IBEW union staffing, an RCDD on staff, on-time/on-budget delivery, and trained installers who design efficient, budget-friendly, future-proof systems.

companies.name: Monterra
companies.description: Monterra provides a software platform for accelerating EV charging site development, aimed at charge point operators, EPCs/developers, and contractors. They emphasize rapid generation of site layouts, infrastructure configurations, and real-time cost estimates, plus automated deliverables (proposals, bills of materials, single-line diagrams), RFQ generation, bid comparison, field data capture, and integrations to streamline project workflows.

companies.name: Mechanical Ingenuity Corporation
companies.description: Mechanical Ingenuity Corporation manufactures finished electronic products and circuit boards and operates an LED lighting division that supplies LED lights, controls, and turnkey retrofit installation services to contractors, architects, manufacturers, and large enterprises; they emphasize decades of manufacturing experience and turnkey LED retrofit services that include rebate processing and installation.

companies.name: Electrical Safety Foundation International
companies.description: Electrical Safety Foundation International provides electrical safety education, public awareness campaigns, and downloadable safety resources for consumers, educators, workplace safety professionals and public service organizations; they emphasize delivering targeted programs (e.g., battery safety, fire prevention, National Electrical Safety Month) and research to inform safe practices.

Nikkon Ferro are manufacturers and exporters of UL-listed copper-bonded grounding rods and earthing accessories serving business customers such as electrical contractors, utilities, telecom and transportation infrastructure operators, and distributors. They emphasize UL and CSA certification, an electroplated permanent copper bond process for corrosion resistance and conductivity, ISO-registered manufacturing, and capabilities for custom machining and testing.
companies.name: Nikkon Ferro

companies.description: Octa Group designs and manufactures machinery and integrated production systems for tube processing and fin production, targeting manufacturers of heat exchangers, HVACR components, and tubular parts in industrial sectors. They supply CNC tube bending machines, fin presses and dies, coil benders, tooling and software, and provide services including spare parts logistics, remote technical assistance, maintenance plans, retrofitting, training, and line relocation. They position themselves as a supplier of digital-ready, integrated work cells and global service solutions.
companies.name: OCTA Group

companies.description: Celec Enterprises manufactures and exports laser land levelers for agricultural field leveling and APFC (automatic power factor correction) panels and relays for commercial and industrial power factor improvement. They serve farms and electrical/industrial customers and claim in-house manufacturing and R&D plus product features such as long laser range, low fuel consumption, energy savings, digital monitoring, and user-friendly APFC controls.
companies.name: Celec Enterprises

companies.description: Shenfang Industrial manufactures and installs electrical conduit and pipe fittings, cable tray systems, and explosion-proof electrical enclosures and accessories for industrial and infrastructure projects. They target business customers in sectors such as power, petrochemical, transportation, and heavy industry, and they claim compliance with international standards (including UL and ISO 9001) while offering competitive pricing and rapid service.
companies.name: Shenfang Industrial

companies.description: simpleSwitch manufactures the simple.Switch energy load management device for residential breaker panels that automatically shares or sheds power between appliances. They target homeowners and electricians via a dealer channel and position the product as a cost-effective, easy-to-install alternative that avoids panel or service upgrades while being UL-tested and certified to applicable standards.
companies.name: simpleSwitch
